column1: # Columns (TAB): kind, owner, required, harness, note.
# owner is tooling-relative. required literals are separated by ;; and must remain in the owner.
# harness selectors are separated by ;;: T1:<case> (tests/cases/<case>.t.sh), T4:<literal>
# (must appear in tests/static.sh), or gap (no executable coverage; explain in note).
# The header gap count must equal the number of gap rows, so a new unmapped or
# uncovered surface fails instead of silently widening the unverified area.
